rationale: The workflow already implements the two applicable evidence-supported optimizations. Dependency downloads are cached via `actions/setup-java@v5` with `cache: maven`, which satisfies P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency cache); the contraindication 'An equivalent cache already exists' applies, so adding a separate `actions/cache` step would be redundant. Stale-run cancellation is already present via `concurrency: group: docker-...` with `cancel-in-progress: true`, satisfying P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE. Other patterns do not fit: there is no build matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST), no schedule trigger (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE), no in-workflow test suite to reorder/select (Maven tests are skipped and coverage is via Docker smoke tests), and no representative duration history sufficient to set a custom timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT). No new network access, secrets, privileged actions, or deployment operations would be introduced, and the existing build and smoke-test coverage is preserved unchanged.
